definitions.gloss: ashamed; embarrassed; unable to face someone
definitions.explanation: Expresses deep shame or embarrassment, especially when one feels unable to face others due to a failure or mistake. Often used as an apology when one has let someone down.

examples.japanese: {面目|めんぼく}ない⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧です。
⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|こた}えられ→応える：09893_kotaeru⟧ず、{面目|めんぼく}ない。
examples.english: I couldn't live up to expectations — I'm ashamed.

examples.japanese: みなさん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧しまい、{面目|めんぼく}ない{気持|きも}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧いっぱいです。
examples.english: I caused everyone trouble and am filled with shame.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦{面目|めんぼく}→面目：09155_menboku⟧ means "face" or "honor" in the social sense. {面目|めんぼく}ない literally means "there is no face" — i.e., one has lost face. It is a relatively formal expression of shame, often used in apologies to superiors or groups.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {面目|めんぼく}ない⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧だ (to be deeply ashamed)
- {面目|めんぼく}ない{気持|きも}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧いっぱいだ (to be filled with shame)
- {面目|めんぼく}ない⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧です (a very formal way to say "I am ashamed")

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{面目|めんぼく}→面目：09155_menboku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to save face
- ⟦{面目|めんぼく}→面目：09155_menboku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose face
- ⟦{面目|めんぼく}→面目：09155_menboku⟧{丸|まる}{潰|つぶ}れ: total loss of face
